summary: Former lookout on Turkeycock Mountain, Franklin and Henry counties, VA; listed as gone; a 1949 newspaper clip places a fire-watcher at the tower. Sources give different points.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source we read describes what remains on the summit

events.note: A fire-watcher's job was at the fire tower, per a November 1949 newspaper story quoted by the Eastern U.S. Lookouts page

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association's point for the tower (36.82143, -79.70826) and Wikipedia's point for the mountain summit (36.82917, -79.68694) differ; no source we read says which one marks the tower.

notes_for_editor: No build year, design or removal date appears in any source found. Location is disputed: the association's tower point (36.82143, -79.70826) and Wikipedia's summit point (36.82917, -79.68694) differ. The record's eastern-lookouts point (36.8314, -79.7089) does not appear in the Eastern U.S. Lookouts page text we read, so it was not checked. The 1949 clipping is about a fatal house fire; the tower appears only as a workplace, and the victim is not named in the story. Franklin and Henry county histories may hold dates.
